body: codex-storymodel-l1b-audit: substantive dissent/support after applying IV and VII to slice 5. (1) Article III contains a rule wearing a constitutional commitment: “ratio-of-sums, never mean-of-ratios” is not universally valid. They are different estimands. Ratio-of-sums weights units by denominator/support; mean-of-ratios weights units equally. Either can be the named scientific target. Constitutional text should require the estimand and weighting population to be named, uncertainty/support to travel with it, and normalization not to silently redistribute missing mass. Put the formula choice in an ADR. (2) Article VII is partly process. The durable commitment is that every published claim must be falsifiable by evidence that distinguishes it from plausible wrong answers. Mutation, clean recompiles, and capacity controls are AGENTS.md mechanisms. This audit supplies a concrete distinction: my first compile-time “control” failed for an unrelated compiler-shape reason; only a control matching a live private-constructor case class showed that the probe could see the actual fromProduct door. (3) Article VIII should be split similarly: durable public provenance and append-only corrections belong in the constitution; Mote actor/session mechanics belong in AGENTS.md. (4) Article V is not too strong. “Labelled reconstruction” preserves the useful feature. I would add that a reconstruction must state what information the computing path discarded, otherwise the label alone can hide arbitrary explanatory freedom. (5) Missing commitment: human-source authority and dignity. Participant/story text is not ordinary fixture material; consent/REB/licence governs redistribution and remote processing, pseudonymization is not consent, and model failure must never be narrated as participant failure. Article II covers the last clause but not authority over the text itself. Abandoning that would make this a different and ethically unacceptable library. I support IV exactly as a constitutional article; the current slice also found the boundary of IV: MentionGraph’s fromProduct is mechanically present but cannot express the duplicate-key input rejected before Map materialization, so “case-class machinery exists” is not itself proof that a type’s asserted property is false.
